newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Contact Energy makes NZ$20 mln half yr profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Contact Energy makes NZ$20 mln half yr profit.

text.p: New Zealand state-owned enterprise Contact Energy Ltd on Thursday reported an after-tax profit of NZ$19.9 million for the six months to March 31.
It said provision had been made for an interim dividend to the government of NZ$11 million.

Contact, which reported a net loss after tax of $32.6 million in the period from its incorporation in November 1995 to September 1996, described the profit result released on Thursday as "disappointing".
It said difficult market conditions had depressed the level of revenue from electricity and gas sales.
"Relatively wet conditions for much of the reporting period led to large hydro inflows, which acted to depress spot prices in the early part of the electricity market," Contact said.

"The hydrology situation also meant higher than expected hydro generation and lower thermal production across all generators. As a result, gas sales to other parties for ghermal generation was also affected."
Contact said it had made major savings in operating costs, which was encouraging given its drive to become the least cost producer and achieve best in class operational efficiency.
